tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search public agent names, descriptions and skills. Returns profile/card URLs and repair_links to stored publisher diagnostics; no task or probe is run.

tools.name: recommend_agents
tools.description:
Recommend agents for a capability or job with matching reasons and caveats.

    Uses exactly the website/API ranking and stored observations, never a live
    task. Filters are requirements, so an empty shortlist is valid. auth is
    'none' or 'declared'; signature is 'verified'; protocol is JSONR

tools.name: get_connection_plan
tools.description:
Read connection metadata for a public agent without connecting to it.

    Accepts a LocalMark agent ID, Agent Card URL, endpoint URL or domain.
    Returns advertised interfaces, authentication scheme metadata, input/output
    modes, skill names and stored evidence. A publisher domain may be
    a

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Browse public agents with pagination and repair_links to read-only publisher diagnostics.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get a full public agent record by LocalMark ID, including original card and complete stored evidence. Collection previews are compact; this explicit detail tool is not truncated.

tools.name: verify_agent
tools.description:
Read stored checks for a card URL, endpoint URL or publisher domain.

    Unseen targets return listing_status 'not_seen', including available
    lookalike-domain hints. Publisher domains may return multiple matches.
    No live request is made to the publisher.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_connection_plan" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Read connection metadata for a public agent without connecting to it. Accepts a LocalMark agent ID, Agent Card URL, endpoint URL or domain. Returns advertised i…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_connection_plan" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_agents" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search public agent names, descriptions, and declared skills. Returns card and profile URLs, not task results." → after: "Search public agent names, descriptions and skills. Returns profile/card URLs and repair_links to stored publisher diagnostics; no task or probe is run."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
